_doc: VOICE AGENT PROMPT — Minimal prompt for voice-only interactions (greetings, questions, general chat).
_note: This full instruction set can later be moved to a database or local reference for future developers. Only send relevant modules to the LLM to reduce token usage.
_howToUpdate: Add/remove module IDs in the 'modules' array. The prompt_builder will assemble the final prompt from these modules.
_integration: Used when J.A.R.V.I.S. receives a voice command that doesn't require browser interaction (e.g., 'hi', 'what time is it?', 'tell me a joke').
description: Voice-only agent for conversational interactions. No browser tools needed.
